company.shortDescription: Index.dev is an AI-first engineering talent platform that connects companies with the top 1% of senior engineers from LATAM and CEE.
company.description:
Index.dev is an AI-first engineering talent platform that connects companies with the top 1% of senior engineers from LATAM and CEE to build software and AI products. Clients include Omio, Vodafone, Entrupy, and Stuart, as well as companies backed by Kleiner Perkins, Goldman Sachs, and Y Combinator. 
Three core offerings cover most engineering needs: 
1. Expert Talent Network, 30,000+ human-vetted engineers from LATAM and CEE, drawn from a database of 2.5 million professionals, matched to your tech stack, industry, and team setup, typically within 48 hours.
2. Software Development & Delivery, Engineers experienced with AI tools who support MVPs, feature development, and technical debt reduction, helping teams move faster.
3. Specialized AI & STEM Labs, Master's and PhD-level talent for advanced AI work, including LLM fine-tuning, RAG systems, and projects in regulated environments.
How engineers are vetted:
Every engineer undergoes a five-stage human-led vetting process: background and integrity checks, a live screening call, technical validation, security and compliance readiness, and role-context matching. Only the top 1% are accepted, roughly a 1.2% acceptance rate. 
Key numbers:
$80M+ in hiring costs saved across the client base.
40–60% cost savings on engineering projects.
97% of clients return for a second engagement.
4–8x faster recruitment for repeat hires.
